messages: alice (releases): Heads-up — BlueHarbor Dedicated slice needs a capacity alignment and version pin before next week. Proposing a night window 2024-11-12 02:00-04:00 UTC. deploybot: Preflight checks queued for slice blueharbor-prod-3. CI artifacts: v2.4.0+opt1 pinned. alice (releases): Key asks: 1) confirm canary traffic plan 2) rollback thresholds 3) SLO impact window. ben (sre): Canary: 5% traffic to 2 pods for 30m, then 20% for 30m, then full. Keep autoscale disabled during canary. carla (oncall): I can cover the 02:00-06:00 UTC window. Will need runbook link and quick way to revert to v2.3.1. erin (pm): Release notes snippet below — small batching change and KV cache tweak. No user-visible API changes. dave (cs): BlueHarbor CS is aware of maintenance window and approved 02:00-04:00 UTC. They asked for no more than 30m of elevated latency. ben (sre): Rollback thresholds: - P95 token latency increase >30% sustained for 10m OR - Error rate (5xx) >1% for 5m -> immediate rollback. carla (oncall): Add alert: perf_regression_blueharbor (p95 > 1.3x baseline). If fired, hit pager and start rollback checklist. deploybot: Canary step started: shifting 5% to v2.4.0+opt1 -> ok. Logs: `canary: blueharbor-prod-3 -> 2 pods` alice (releases): Quick QA: smoke test suite ran on canary, 12/12 passed, one flaky embedding seed test — not related. ben (sre): After 60m of stable canary we'll promote to 20% then watch. If all good, schedule full shift at 03:20 UTC. erin (pm): Confirmed metrics to watch: p95 latency, 5xx rate, token throughput, and cost burn (tokens/sec). alice (releases): Pin: deployment manifest will lock image tag `redwood/inference:v2.4.0-opt1` and model bundle `m/redwood-gptq-13b@2024-10-28`. Add to release notes. dave (cs): Noted — customer asked we notify them when canary hits 20%. carla (oncall): Got it, I'll ping BlueHarbor slack channel at 03:00 UTC. deploybot: Promotion to 20% scheduled at 02:40 UTC -> queued. deploybot: Canary 20% -> success. Metrics: p95 +5%, 5xx 0.02%. ben (sre): Looks good. Proceed to full rollout in slices: drain extra capacity in slice-4 then shift traffic gradually. alice (releases): Final approval: everyone okay with 02:00-04:00 UTC window and rollback criteria? :thumbsup: ben (sre): :thumbsup: carla (oncall): :thumbsup: erin (pm): :thumbsup: dave (cs): :thumbsup: alice (releases): Great — locking window and pin. Post-deploy checklist: update release notes, tag changelog, and run full smoke suite at 04:15 UTC. Closing thread unless any objections.
